hints.title: Day by Day Secret Holders
hints.text: Track the count of people who newly discover the secret on each calendar day.

hints.title: Sharing Window
hints.text: A person who learns the secret on day d can share it from day d + delay up through day d + forget - 1.

hints.title: Sliding Sharing Window
hints.text: Maintain a running sum of active sharers by adding newly eligible people and subtracting those who forget.

hints.title: Linear Sliding Sharing Implementation

complexity.notes: Maintains running sum of eligible sharers in O(1) per day.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing active cohorts naively each day takes O(n * forget) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: DP array stores cohort counts per day.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses rolling sliding window to calculate eligible sharers in linear time.
